attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole body is two sentences: «Ο Άγιος Erconwald (Ερκονγουάλδος) κοιμήθηκε το έτος 693 μ.Χ. Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του» — he fell asleep in the year 693, and we have no other details of his life. The page credits the Archdiocese of Thyateira and Great Britain as its source for the entry. **saint.gr spells the name in Latin letters in the day's line** and gives a Greek form only in brackets on the life page, which is the form recorded in `names`; no English form is on the page, so the display name is this corpus's own choice of the usual English spelling of that name. No `locations` was written: the see is named and nothing else is. It prints no hymn and names no relic, and the corpus holds nobody of this name.
